svg.font-family: Avenir Next, Nunito, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: The act-gate — N−1 read-only, one actor
the only one that may act
Session lifecycle — four transitions, one resident session
Route across harness lanes — role → lane → gate
The seat is the executor — background only in the idle
shadow · warm · probe — one background pool
Staged admission — shadow before it may act
The verifier is ground truth, not a session
Only one ledger — the fsync'd box is the only truth
One local box — a defect, N agents, one writer
a different lane than the fix
tokens free · no rate limit · on your box
off the box · outlives the box
